The '''Moddell sector''' was a subsector of the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Part of the Zuma sector's [[Inner Zuma Region]], above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] plane, it was divided into the [[Inner Moddell systems]] and the [[Outer Moddell systems]]. The sector included the worlds [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]], and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the site of the famous [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Notable [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] included the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and the [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzums]].

==Geography==
[[File:Moddell.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Another map of the sector.]]
The Moddell sector included nearly two hundred uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|systems]], from anonymous red dwarfs to the young [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giants]] at the heart of the [[Monsua Nebula/Legends|Monsua Nebula]]. In addition, the sector theoretically extended for nearly a hundred [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] toward [[Firrerre/Legends|Firrerre]] and [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], territory that included thousands upon thousands of systems.<ref name="Atlas" />

Most of the sector's traffic was found on the [[Annaj-Houche Run]] between [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] (the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]]) and [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]]; those worlds, along with [[Vex system/Legends|Vex]], [[Qina/Legends|Qina]], and [[Kuna's Tooth/Legends|Kuna's Tooth]], made up the [[Inner Moddell systems]]. Traffic dropped off considerably in the [[Outer Moddell systems|Outer Moddell]] beyond those systems.<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
The Moddell sector and the surrounding regions were considered part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] until the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic's]] final centuries, and were admitted as [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] around [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually made the Zuma a regional [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and the Moddell sector one of its subsectors.<ref name="EAOC" />

[[File:BattleofEndor.png|thumb|left|225px|The [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]
Very few people had ever heard of this remote sector until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] undertook the construction project of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Atlas" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Moddell sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" /> After the battle, the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] briefly made its headquarters on the Forest Moon, only to be [[Nagai–Tof War|driven off]] by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]]. The sector has been represented by the region's dominant species, the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]].<ref name="Atlas" />

A few entrepreneurs tried to attract tourists to the Moddell sector, but little came of their efforts; the only industry to gain a foothold in the Moddell since then has been illicit trade in the narcotic [[Rokna Blue]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat]], [[Adega]], [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], [[Courkrus|Khuiumin]], [[Basilisk]], [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]], and [[Hosrel XI|Hozrel XI]] in the Moddell Sector. Agrilat is a swampy region of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], not a separate planet; Adega is not a planet in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Legends|continuity]] and is likely intended to reference the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]; the [[Adega system/Legends|Adega system]], however, as well as the planets [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] and [[Courkrus|Khuiumin]], are all in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]]; [[Basilisk]] is in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]; [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]] is in the [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] near [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]; and [[Hosrel XI|Hozrel XI]] is in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].
